# iosxr_clock (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxr_clock" "example" {
  timezone = "America-New_York"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone identifier (replace slashes with hyphens, e.g. America-New_York for America/New_York)

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
